ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is at the top of the food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The title in the diagram is “Food Chain,” and it shows an ocean food chain. The labeled organisms include, in order, phytoplankton, zooplankton, small fish, mackerel, mahi mahi, and large shark. The red energy-flow arrows point from phytoplankton to zooplankton, then to small fish, mackerel, mahi mahi, and finally to large shark. Then reason: The top of the food chain is the organism that obtains energy last and is not shown as being eaten by other organisms. The last organism in the diagram is large shark.
